description: This file defines utility functions for working with string enums and channel target schemas using the @sinclair/typebox library. It provides type-safe schema builders with descriptive options and enforces specific enum and array schemas in a consistent manner.

methods.name: export function stringEnum<T extends readonly string[]>( stringEnum
methods.description: Creates a string enum validator schema with optional description and title, based on provided string values.

methods.name: export function optionalStringEnum<T extends readonly string[]>( optionalStringEnum
methods.description: Creates an optional string enum validator schema based on provided string values.

methods.name: export function channelTargetSchema(options?: { description?: string }) { channelTargetSchema
methods.description: Creates a string schema for channel target descriptions, with optional override for description text.

methods.name: export function channelTargetsSchema(options?: { description?: string }) { channelTargetsSchema
methods.description: Creates an array schema of channel target strings, using channelTargetSchema for individual items.
